open_points.subject: R0-07 first-administrator bootstrap and M36 AuditRecord
open_points.text: State 0 R0-07 says the bootstrap command is "never printed, logged or audited, except that the success message shows the normalized email"; State 1 M36 says "The first-administrator bootstrap of R0-07 is no exception: it writes one `staff.create` record".
open_points.question: Does successful creation of the first administrator create an AuditRecord?
options: Create no audit record, as R0-07 requires.
Create one system-authored `staff.create` AuditRecord, as M36 requires.
open_points.default_guess: Treat the specific product decision R0-07 as authoritative and create no audit record.

witness.initial: An empty deployment has no StaffAccount and no AuditRecord.
events: The host operator runs the local bootstrap command with an email and password.
The command successfully creates the first active administrator.
outcomes: Only the StaffAccount is persisted; no audit record exists, per R0-07.
The StaffAccount and a system-authored `staff.create` AuditRecord are persisted, per M36.
witness.observer: A host operator or auditor inspecting the audit history.
